_comment: REFERENCE ONLY. This file documents the catalog data shape for a possible future dynamic build (e.g. if a payment system is added). It is NOT fetched or rendered by any page. The live catalog is hardcoded in supplies.html and this file is kept in sync by hand. Prices and descriptions are real client data. SKUs are sequential placeholders, not real client SKUs. Note: item-003/item-004 (Hot Dog Container, 125ct/500ct) and item-005/item-022 & item-006/item-023 (the 1- and 3-Compartment containers, 200ct/100ct) are each two rows here (one per SKU/pack size), but supplies.html renders each pair as a single merged card with two stacked prices -- a deliberate Phase 1 display exception, not a data mismatch to fix. The new 100ct rows (item-022, item-023) were appended at the end rather than inserted near their 200ct siblings to keep existing SKUs/ids stable.
